{{Quote|We are Jedi, sent by Typha-Dor ... You must be Shalini."<br />"So our leaders have remembered we exist..."<br />"But where are the rest? There are supposed to be ten of you."<br />"Not anymore ... We had a saboteur in our midst.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Shalini, crew leader of the TY44 outpost|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref>}}
'''TY44''' was the name of one of a "string" of [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]]-[[moon]]s orbiting the planet [[Typha-Dor]], located in the [[Uziel system]].

Named for its coordinates, TY44 had a very icy terrain and its surface was covered with glaciers.

By [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], a surveillance outpost of [[Typha-Dor]] was located on this moon. Several of its resistance fighter-crew members were eliminated by the would-be invaders of their home planet, expansionist forces from [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] who sent in a [[Mezdec|saboteur]] to infiltrate the crew's operations and assassinate its members.

In 25 BBY, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were [[Mission to Typha-Dor|sent to rescue]] the outpost's surviving crew members by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] at the request of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
